meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Withdraw" opens the "Withdrawing Order..." window
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary containing the invited vendor's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Ensure counter-offer controls are not hidden on RFQs.
Use the required buyer bid-control configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its Responses view.
Navigate to the buyer's RFQ Responses screen described in the scenario.
Open Withdraw from the RFQ Settings menu without confirming the action.
Assert that the withdrawal dialog opens.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Assert the dialog's required withdrawal-reason instruction.
Assert the withdrawal reason field is present.
Assert the dialog offers Cancel before any state change.
Assert the dialog offers Yes without pressing it.
